# Parse Gmail outbox threads for recommended ARTISTS
from collections import defaultdict
import re

# recompute thread_ids_all to ensure complete pagination
query='Recommendations for Music Artists'
page_limit=20
thread_ids_all=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    res=apis.gmail.show_outbox_threads(access_token=gmail_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page',page_index,'len',len(res))
    if not res:
        break
    thread_ids_all += [t['email_thread_id'] for t in res]
    page_index += 1
print('total threads',len(thread_ids_all))

artist_sources=defaultdict(list)  # name -> list of (source, from_name, thread_id, email_id)

pattern = re.compile(r'favorites\s+artists\s*[,:]?\s*(.*)', re.IGNORECASE|re.DOTALL)

for tid in thread_ids_all:
    th=apis.gmail.show_thread(access_token=gmail_token, email_thread_id=tid)
    for e in th['emails']:
        body=e.get('body','')
        # Skip Miranda's own emails by checking sender email
        sender_email=e['sender']['email']
        if sender_email.lower()=='mir-powe@gmail.com':
            continue
        m=pattern.search(body)
        if not m:
            continue
        rest=m.group(1)
        # Take only first line/sentence-ish
        rest=rest.replace('\n',' ').strip()
        # remove trailing stuff after maybe '"' or 'Thanks' etc? We'll just cut at first period if exists and seems part of list
        # But list may end with period; so keep until end.
        rest=re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', rest)
        # Trim common trailing phrases
        rest=re.sub(r'(\.|!|\?)\s*$', '', rest)
        # Now split by commas
        parts=[p.strip() for p in rest.split(',') if p.strip()]
        # For each part, split on ' and ' if needed
        final_parts=[]
        for p in parts:
            if ' and ' in p:
                final_parts += [x.strip() for x in p.split(' and ') if x.strip()]
            else:
                final_parts.append(p)
        # Filter tokens that look like names (contain at least one letter)
        names=[x for x in final_parts if re.search(r'[A-Za-z]', x)]
        # Clean trailing punctuation
        names=[re.sub(r'^[\-–\s]+|[\-–\s]+$', '', x) for x in names]
        if names:
            for name in names:
                artist_sources[name].append({'thread_id':tid,'email_id':e['email_id'],'from_name':e['sender']['name'],'from_email':sender_email})

print('unique artists found',len(artist_sources))
print('sample artists',list(artist_sources.keys())[:10])
# Show verification table for first 15 artists
items=[]
for name,srcs in artist_sources.items():
    src=srcs[0]
    items.append((name, len(srcs), src['thread_id'], src['email_id'], src['from_name']))
items_sorted=sorted(items, key=lambda x:x[0])
print('First rows:')
for row in items_sorted[:20]:
    print(row)

def extract_names_from_phone(text):
    if not re.search(r"favorites?\s+artists", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE):

    m=re.search(r"favorites?\s+artists\s*,?\s*(.*)", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE|re.DOTALL)
    if not m:
        return []
    rest=m.group(1).strip()
    rest=re.split(r"\b(favorite songs|songs)\b", rest, flags=re.IGNORECASE)[0]
    rest=rest.strip(' .!?:;\n\t')
